group-2020-ii-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明性建议文，主题为如何与医生有效沟通(Talking with your doctor)。文章用引言段点题，随后以多个小标题(Stay positive / Keep track of how you are feeling / Ask questions 等)分条给出建议。七选五考查引言段总起句(36)、各小标题段落内的衔接句(37、38、40)以及缺失的小标题本身(39)。

discourseStructure.summary: 引言段先说明与医生坦诚沟通的好处并鼓励读者，36空作为引言段收尾、总起全文分条建议；其后每个小标题段围绕一条建议展开，空格分别承担段内衔接(37、38、40)与小标题(39)的作用。

units.heading: Talking with your doctor
units.summary: 引言段说明坦诚沟通的益处并鼓励读者不要害怕，36空收束引言并引出下文的若干建议。

units.heading: Stay positive.
units.summary: 建议带着好心态就诊，37空补充医生和护理者与你站在同一边，呼应teamwork。

units.heading: Keep track of how you are feeling.
units.summary: 建议记录身体感受，38空作段首总起，后文This指代该记录行为带来的好处。

units.heading: 39 (missing heading)
units.summary: 39空是缺失的小标题，下段解释medical history的内容，故标题应是带上病史与用药清单。

units.heading: Ask questions.
units.summary: 建议大胆提问并把问题写下带去，40空承接写清单这一动作，说明这样能更容易得到答案。

topicClues: discuss something that is bothering you

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Don’t be afraid or embarrassed to discuss something that is bothering you.

mechanismSignals.signalText: tips for talking with your doctor
mechanismSignals.targetText: Talking with your doctor / Stay positive
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中 tips for talking with your doctor 与标题及下文的分条小标题构成总—分话题场，作引言收尾的总起句。

mechanismSignals.targetText: tips for talking with your doctor
mechanismSignals.relation: 前文反复出现 talking with your doctor，与选项 tips for talking with your doctor 同属沟通就医话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Stay positive / Keep track of how you are feeling / Ask questions
mechanismSignals.relation: some tips 复数预指下文以小标题列出的各条建议，是总起句的语篇标志。

optionFit.fitSummary: 36空在引言段末尾，需要一句总起句引出下文以小标题分条罗列的建议；B项 Here are some tips for talking with your doctor 既呼应标题，又用 some tips 预指后面各条提示，承上启下。

matchedClues.contextSide: Stay positive / Keep track of how you are feeling / Ask questions
matchedClues.relation: some tips 概指下文各小标题列出的若干条建议。

matchedClues.optionSide: tips for talking with your doctor
matchedClues.relation: 选项措辞直接回扣文章标题，点明全文主题。

keyDistractors.reason: E项 your doctor and other caregivers are on your side 更适合放在 Stay positive 段(37空)收束鼓励，无法总起下文分条建议。

q-2020-ii-036.teachingNote: 引言段末的空通常是总起句，看后文是否以分条小标题展开，若是则选含 tips/ways 等总括词、并回扣标题的选项。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Go to your doctor’s visits with a good attitude.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 on your side 与空后 Think teamwork 同属合作/同一阵营话题场，构成因—果式呼应。
空后 Think teamwork 把医生与你视为一个团队，正照应选项 doctor and other caregivers are on your side。
前文 good attitude 与小标题 Stay positive 营造积极态度话题场，为 doctor are on your side 的鼓励语提供语境。

optionFit.fitSummary: 37空在 Stay positive 段中部，前有 good attitude、后有 Think teamwork，E项 your doctor and other caregivers are on your side 解释为何要保持积极并把就诊当作团队协作，与前后语意自然衔接。

matchedClues.optionSide: your doctor and other caregivers are on your side
matchedClues.relation: 医生与护理者和你站在同一边，正是 teamwork 的具体含义。
Remember 引出令人安心的提醒，强化保持积极态度的理由。

keyDistractors.reason: C项 talk to another doctor if the treatments don’t work 谈的是换医生，与本段保持积极、团队协作的语义场不符。

q-2020-ii-037.teachingNote: 段中空要前后兼顾，抓住后文关键词(此处 teamwork)找出与之同属一个话题场、能解释该词的选项。

topicClues: Keep track of how you are feeling
how you feel and how long you’ve felt

contextEvidence.headingAnchor: Keep track of how you are feeling.
contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Keep track of how you are feeling.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: This will make it easier for you to answer questions about your symptoms

mechanismSignals.targetText: keep notes on how you are feeling
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 This 指代空格句所述动作，即选项中的 keep notes on how you are feeling，构成段首句与后文的指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.signalText: keep notes on how you are feeling
mechanismSignals.targetText: Keep track of how you are feeling
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 keep notes on how you are feeling 与小标题 Keep track of how you are feeling 几乎同义复现，确认本段主题句。

mechanismSignals.targetText: keep notes on how you are feeling
mechanismSignals.relation: 小标题 how you are feeling 与选项措辞完全一致，属同一话题场的词汇复现。

optionFit.fitSummary: 38空在段首，需要一句承接小标题 Keep track of how you are feeling 的主题句；D项 Before your doctor’s visit, keep notes on how you are feeling 与小标题同义，且空后 This 正指代这一记录动作。

matchedClues.optionSide: keep notes on how you are feeling
matchedClues.relation: This 回指 keep notes 这一行为，说明记录带来的好处。

matchedClues.contextSide: Keep track of how you are feeling
matchedClues.optionSide: keep notes on how you are feeling
matchedClues.relation: 选项与小标题同义改写，是本段总起句。

keyDistractors.reason: A项 This will make getting answers easier 也以 This 开头，但它本身以指代词起句、缺少被指代的动作，不能充当段首主题句，更适合40空。

q-2020-ii-038.teachingNote: 段首空多为主题句，优先选与本段小标题同义复现的选项；同时检查后文指代词(This)需要指向空格句所述的具体动作。

topicClues: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses

contextEvidence.headingAnchor: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses, treatments
contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses, treatments
contextEvidence.afterQuote: if you are allergic (过敏) to any medicines, be sure to mention that to your doctor

mechanismSignals.targetText: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 medical history 与空后段首句 Your medical history 词汇复现，确认本空是该段缺失的小标题。
下段以 Your medical history 展开解释，正照应小标题 Bring your medical history。

mechanismSignals.targetText: a list of your current medicines
mechanismSignals.relation: 下文提到 allergic to any medicines，与选项 a list of your current medicines 同属用药信息话题场。

optionFit.fitSummary: 39空是用●引出的缺失小标题，下段紧接解释 Your medical history 及用药情况；F项 Bring your medical history, including a list of your current medicines 与下文同主题、且为祈使句式，符合各小标题的体例。

matchedClues.contextSide: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses
matchedClues.relation: 选项与下段开头同词复现，点明本段主题。

matchedClues.optionSide: a list of your current medicines
matchedClues.relation: 下文谈及用药过敏，呼应选项中的 current medicines。

keyDistractors.reason: D项也含 Before your doctor’s visit 的祈使句式，但其主题是记录感受，与本段 medical history/medicines 的话题场不符，已用于38空。

q-2020-ii-039.teachingNote: 用●引出的空格是小标题，找与紧随其后段落同义复现、且为祈使句体例的选项。

topicClues: ask your doctor any questions you have
write them down and bring the list

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: write them down and bring the list with you to your appointment.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Remember—there’s no such thing as a stupid question.

mechanismSignals.targetText: write them down and bring the list with you to your appointment
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项以 This 开头，回指空前的动作 write them down and bring the list，构成指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.targetText: ask your doctor any questions / the answer to a question
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 getting answers 与本段 ask questions、the answer to a question 同属问答话题场。

mechanismSignals.signalText: write them down and bring the list
mechanismSignals.targetText: This will make getting answers easier
mechanismSignals.relation: 前文写下问题并带去的动作，正是选项 This 所指、并说明这样能更容易得到答案。

optionFit.fitSummary: 40空在 Ask questions 段中部，前句讲把问题写下并带去就诊；A项 This will make getting answers easier 用 This 回指该动作，并点出此举的好处，自然衔接前后文。

matchedClues.contextSide: write them down and bring the list
matchedClues.relation: This 指代前文写下并带去问题清单这一行为。

matchedClues.contextSide: ask your doctor any questions you have
matchedClues.relation: 提问的目的是得到答案，选项 getting answers 紧扣本段问答主题。

keyDistractors.reason: G项 Writing down what the doctor says 谈的是记录医生所说的话，方向与本句强调把自己的问题写下带去相反，容易因 writing down 而误选。

q-2020-ii-040.teachingNote: 以 This/That 开头的选项要回指前句具体动作，结合后文判断该动作带来的结果，确认指代与逻辑都通顺。
